notes.title: 🎉 Occulto - 101 % Funded on Kickstarter! 🎉
notes.content:
Occulto has been 101% FUNDED on Kickstarter! 🎉💚

A huge thank you to all our BACKERS and FRIENDS who helped us reach this incredible milestone! ✨

Even though the campaign has ended, late pledges with exclusive content are still available! Don't miss out—check them out now! 🔮👉 https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1117146839/occulto?ref=5jueli

We can't thank you enough—every single contribution has been essential in making this campaign a success. In fact, we reached almost exactly 100% of our goal!

The last day was absolutely incredible, and we want to share some highlights with you:

Unfortunately, we didn’t achieve a high visibility on kickstarter, so the majority of our success came from the substantial contributions of those who truly believed in our adventure.

Honestly, we didn’t expect to make it—but here we are, thanks to you!

In our next updates, we’ll talk about the future of the game and its development progress. Stay tuned!
